##### Project general facts

The Cove 2 by Emaar Properties is a premium waterfront development located in Dubai Creek Harbour, offering a refined collection of 1 to 3 bedroom apartments, as well as 2 to 4 bedroom townhouses and duplexes. Set within the vibrant Creek Island, the project features contemporary multi-storey buildings designed with elegant architecture and functional layouts, creating a harmonious blend of style and comfort. Surrounded by the marina, promenade, and stunning skyline views, it delivers a distinctive waterfront lifestyle.

Residents enjoy a wide range of amenities and services that support a balanced and elevated lifestyle, including landscaped leisure areas, waterfront walkways, and spaces for relaxation and social interaction. The development is thoughtfully planned to provide seamless access to everything needed for modern living, creating a dynamic community atmosphere with a strong connection to the surroundings.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that offer panoramic views of the Dubai skyline and waterfront. Living spaces are bright and open, designed for comfort and elegance. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Creek Island is a waterfront development that mixes upscale residences with enticing leisure and recreational amenities to create a world-class waterfront community. The district’s green central park, stunning marina, yacht club, and five-star hotels will all be popular destinations for residents to enjoy the district’s breathtaking views and memorable experiences. Creek Beach is conceived to offered you the ultimate family-friendly retreat. From 700 metres of pristine white sands to the infinity pool and spectacular sunset views, this is paradise reborn.

The centerpiece of Dubai Creek Harbour is the breathtaking Dubai Creek Tower, set to surpass the Burj Khalifa as the tallest structure globally. This architectural marvel is designed by the renowned architect Santiago Calatrava and will serve as a symbol of Dubai's ambition and innovation. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a diverse range of residential options, from luxurious waterfront apartments to contemporary villas. The residences boast stunning views of the Dubai skyline, the Creek, and the iconic tower.

Dubai Creek Harbour represents a bold vision for the future of Dubai, blending cutting-edge design, sustainability, and cultural richness to create a dynamic and iconic waterfront destination. It not only serves as a testament to Dubai's commitment to innovation but also as a symbol of its ambition to create world-class living spaces.
